title: Freya Synthetic Brief Dataset
how_to_use: Use briefs/*.json as synthetic input briefs for the builder.
Use expected_rules/*.json as semantic extraction expectations for tests, not as runtime data supplied to the builder.
Use test_cases/*.json or test_cases.json as scenario templates; supply concrete fixture values and bind to the official mock bank API.
Use dataset_manifest.json for splits and provenance.
Use test_strategy.json to stage testing from unit tests to official benchmark.
important: This is an original synthetic dataset, not the official hackathon kit.
Do not hardcode sample names, case IDs, dates, amounts, or policy values in builder code.
The tool names are listed for orientation; request/response fields must come from tools/openapi.json.
The test case templates are semantic oracles and are not directly executable until fixtures and the harness are connected.
